outerExpiryCommitmentRule.returnedBeforeExpiry: A logical-operation failure (git-timeout, unsupported-resource-limit or any other operation code) already returned to a verifier stage before outer cancellation or expiry stands; the later outer event only starts the emergency retirement allowance. Full-result case: per-op-timeout-returned-then-outer-expiry-in-teardown.
outerExpiryCommitmentRule.notReturnedBeforeExpiry: Otherwise arbitration at the active checkpoint applies the precedence list: outer-cancellation-or-deadline outranks the operation cause and yields verification-timeout at that checkpoint. Full-result case: per-op-timeout-unreturned-then-outer-expiry-in-teardown.
outerExpiryCommitmentRule.ownership: Failed or unobserved teardown is ownership-or-cleanup-failure, rank 1, in both branches: repository/unsupported-process-containment.
